findings.message: Removal of libgomp1_libs slice from runtime-libraries stage-packages causes recipe regression. Evidence establishes that demo-app's --engine parallel option requires libgomp.so.1, which this slice alone supplies in the prior rootfs. Removing it will cause /usr/bin/demo serve --engine parallel to fail at startup with an unresolved library error. Restore the slice or confirm service configuration has changed.

summary: Commit bump from 000000000000000000000000000000000000000e to 000000000000000000000000000000000000000f removes libgomp1_libs slice from runtime-libraries stage-packages, causing runtime library regression for demo-app parallel engine startup.
